title: The Story Told in Turns
youtube_title: The Story Told in Turns | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Asking for a second pair of hands is a skill.
summary: At a cottage room with a long tablecloth and paper stars, a story told in turns of two sentences each will go wrong if one person rushes. Jorie and Eitan split it into two slow jobs, while the baker only offers a count or a name for the knot they need. They finish together.
